newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up after range trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures mostly up after range trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer except for the March contract on Friday after moving within narrow ranges throughout the day, traders said.
Benchmark August was up 0.7 yen at 151.5 yen. Other prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen firmer.
Trading was sluggish in a market lacking direction.
"Bargain-hunting buying provided support to the market," one trader said.
"But weaker overseas markets along with flat Thai rubber offer prices to Japan capped price gains," the trader said.
